source.endorsement: This product uses Census Bureau data but is not endorsed or certified by the Census Bureau.

disclaimer: ACS figures are survey estimates with margins of error. Five-year vintages are period estimates (2019 covers 2015–2019 and 2024 covers 2020–2024). Dollar comparisons across vintages are nominal. State medians are the official state estimates, not averages of counties.
default_caveats: ACS 5-year estimates are survey-based period estimates (e.g. 2024 = 2020-2024 average), not point-in-time counts.
Every estimate has a 90% margin of error (MOE); differences smaller than the combined MOE may not be statistically significant.
Do not compare overlapping 5-year windows (e.g. 2021 vs 2024) as if they were independent; compare non-overlapping vintages (2019 vs 2024).
Dollar values are in each vintage's own inflation-adjusted dollars; cross-year dollar comparisons are nominal.

metrics.name: total_population
metrics.label: Total population
caveats: County totals are controlled to Census population estimates, so the API reports no MOE (code -555555555 -> NULL).

metrics.name: median_household_income
metrics.label: Median household income
metrics.description: Median household income in the past 12 months (ACS B19013), in vintage-year inflation-adjusted dollars.
caveats: Medians cannot be summed or averaged across counties; the state value is the official state median.

metrics.name: median_age
metrics.label: Median age
metrics.description: Median age of the total population (ACS B01002).
caveats: Medians are not additive across geographies.

metrics.name: hispanic_population
metrics.label: Hispanic or Latino population
metrics.description: Hispanic or Latino population of any race (ACS B03002_012).
caveats: Hispanic origin is an ethnicity; Hispanic people may be of any race.

metrics.name: hispanic_share
metrics.label: Hispanic share of population
metrics.description: Share of the population that is Hispanic or Latino.
caveats: Ratio of two estimates; its MOE is not provided here (see Census ACS handbook ch. 8 for the ratio formula).

metrics.name: population_growth
metrics.label: Population growth
metrics.description: Relative change in total population between two non-overlapping ACS 5-year vintages. `year` filters the END year.
caveats: NULL when either vintage is missing or the start value is 0.
Only non-overlapping windows (>= 5 years apart) are returned.

metrics.name: median_household_income_growth
metrics.label: Median household income growth (nominal)
metrics.description: Relative change in median household income between non-overlapping vintages, NOT inflation-adjusted.
caveats: Nominal dollars: part of the change is inflation (CPI-U rose roughly 20%+ between the 2019 and 2024 vintages' reference dollars).
